title: Marketing Manager
description:
Wolviston Management Services are proud to be recruiting on behalf of Tioxide Materials Ltd for an experienced and commercially focused Marketing Manager.

About the Role
This is a strategic marketing position where you will play a key role in supporting business growth, customer retention, and market positioning.
Working within the Commercial Operations team, based in Stockton, you will partner closely with Sales, Technical, Product and senior stakeholders to provide insight-led marketing strategies that influence decision-making and drive performance.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver marketing strategies aligned to business objectives
- Provide market intelligence, competitor analysis, and customer insights
- Identify market trends, opportunities, and evolving customer needs
- Support customer segmentation, value propositions, and route-to-market strategies
- Work collaboratively with Sales, Technical Service and Product teams
- Analyse market and sales data to support growth and margin improvement
- Support product development, new applications, and market entry strategies
- Contribute to pricing, product mix, and commercial planning
- Create high-quality reports, presentations, and business cases
- Guide externally delivered campaigns and promotional activity
- Manage relationships with external marketing agencies
- Monitor performance and continuously improve marketing effectiveness

About You
You will be a strategic thinker with strong commercial awareness and the ability to turn complex data into actionable insight.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Experience in strategic, product, or commercial marketing
- Degree in Marketing, Business or related discipline, or CIM qualification
- Experience within a B2 B, manufacturing, industrial or technical environment
- Strong understanding of segmentation, positioning, and value propositions
- Proven ability to use market intelligence and customer data to support decisions
- Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills
- Commercially driven with a focus on growth, margin, and customer retention
- Strong organisational and project management skills

Desirable
- Experience in chemical, coatings, plastics, or process industries
- Exposure to international markets or distributor networks
- Product or technical marketing background
- Experience using CRM or business intelligence tools
- CIM Chartered Marketer status (or working towards)

Why Apply?
This is an exciting opportunity to join a well-established and technically focused organisation where marketing plays a key role in shaping commercial strategy.
You will have the opportunity to influence senior decision-making and contribute directly to business growth.

title: Senior Client Marketing Manager
description:
This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing B2 B marketing agency based in Northumberland working with regional, national and international clients across sectors including engineering, manufacturing, technology, renewables and life sciences. The business delivers integrated marketing services including PR, digital marketing, content, design, SEO and website development, helping innovative organisations grow their visibility and market presence.

The Senior Client Marketing Manager will look after a portfolio of client accounts, building strong relationships and helping to grow existing business. The role involves developing marketing plans, overseeing campaigns, and working closely with clients to ensure activity delivers against their objectives and supports long-term growth.

Job Responsibilities:
- Managing and developing a portfolio of client accounts, building strong relationships with key stakeholders.
- Acting as the main point of contact for clients, providing strategic marketing advice and ensuring a high level of service.
- Creating marketing strategies and campaign plans that support client objectives and deliver results.
- Working with internal teams across content, PR, digital, design and web to deliver integrated marketing campaigns.
- Identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts and supporting business development activities.
- Ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to a high standard.
- Driving client retention through proactive account management and consistent value delivery.
- Keeping campaigns and marketing initiatives on track, ensuring agreed actions are completed and objectives are achieved.

Job Requirements:
- Experience managing and growing B2 B client accounts, ideally within an agency environment or across multiple businesses and brands as part of a wider group.
- A strong marketing background with experience developing marketing strategies and integrated campaigns that deliver results.
- The ability to understand client objectives and turn them into effective marketing plans and campaigns.
- Experience managing multiple projects and working with a range of internal teams to deliver successful outcomes.
- A track record of identifying opportunities to grow client accounts and increase revenue.
- Excellent relationship-building, communication and presentation skills.
- Strong commercial awareness and the ability to balance client needs with business objectives.
- A proactive, organised approach and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- A genuine interest in working with innovative businesses across technical and specialist sectors.

title: Digital PR Consultant
company: BMC Recruitment Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Description: Digital PR Consultant
Location: North East England (Hybrid) Salary: Up to £40,000 Agency Environment
A well-established and growing integrated marketing agency in the North East is looking to appoint a Digital PR Consultant to join its expanding team. Due to continued client growth and increasing demand for Digital PR services, this is an opportunity to take ownership of campaigns, build strong client relationships, and deliver impactful results across a diverse client portfolio.
This position would suit an ambitious Digital PR professional who enjoys hands-on campaign delivery, media relations, content ideation, and securing high-quality coverage.
The Role
As a Digital PR Consultant, you'll be responsible for planning and delivering Digital PR campaigns that generate meaningful media coverage, backlinks, brand awareness, and commercial results for clients.
Working closely with clients and internal specialists, you'll develop creative campaign ideas, build relationships with journalists, and drive coverage across national, regional, trade, and online publications.
Key Responsibilities
- Deliver Digital PR campaigns from concept through to execution.
- Develop creative story angles and outreach strategies.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, influencers, and key media contacts.
- Secure high-quality media coverage and backlinks across relevant publications.
- Create press releases, media pitches, and supporting campaign content.
- Manage day-to-day client communication and reporting.
- Monitor campaign performance and provide insight-driven recommendations.
- Collaborate with SEO, Content, Social, and Marketing teams to maximise campaign impact.
- Identify reactive PR opportunities and newsjacking opportunities.
- Support the development of new campaign ideas and ongoing client growth.

About You
We're keen to speak with candidates who have:
- Previous experience within Digital PR, PR, Content Marketing, or a related agency environment.
- A proven track record of securing media coverage and building journalist relationships.
- Strong written communication and storytelling abilities.
- Experience managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
- Commercial awareness and confidence working directly with clients.
- A proactive, creative approach to campaign generation.
- Knowledge of SEO and link-building principles would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer
- Salary up to £40,000 depending on experience.
- Hybrid working model.
- Genuine opportunities for progression and development.
- A collaborative and supportive agency culture.
- The chance to work with a wide range of well-known brands and exciting clients.
- A business that continues to invest heavily in its Digital PR offering and future growth plans.

title: PPC & SEO Account Executive Permanent - North Tyneside
description:
PPC & SEO Account Executive

Hybrid Working Minimum 2 Days Office-Based Mon & Wed
Up to £37,000 per annum
Full-Time, 37 Hours per Week

We are looking for a PPC & SEO Account Executive to join our clients growing marketing team. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded digital marketer who thrives on improving performance, uncovering opportunities, and staying ahead in the ever evolving world of search.

Working closely with the Marketing Lead, you'll take ownership of day-to-day PPC and SEO activity, helping to drive visibility, traffic, conversions and ultimately product sales across Google, Amazon, Bing and emerging AI-powered search platforms.

The successful candidate will have a solid understanding of both PPC and SEO and, importantly, how the two disciplines work together to influence customer purchasing behaviour and drive product sales. You'll be comfortable managing paid search campaigns, supporting organic growth strategies and identifying opportunities to improve performance through both on-site optimisation and off-site link-building activity.

What You'll Be Doing

PPC Management

Build, launch and optimise campaigns across multiple advertising platforms, including Google Ads, Amazon Advertising, Facebook Ads and emerging AI-powered advertising platforms

Manage and optimise campaigns focused on driving online product sales and revenue growth, monitoring ROAS, conversion rates and commercial performance

Conduct keyword research, create compelling ad copy and manage bids, budgets and campaign performance

Monitor account performance daily, identifying opportunities for growth and optimisation

Run A/B testing across audiences, ad copy and landing pages to improve conversion rates and increase product sales

Analyse campaign data and provide recommendations to maximise ROI and revenue

Manage advertising budgets effectively to deliver strong value for money and commercial results

SEO & Organic Search

Conduct keyword research, mapping and content gap analysis

Optimise website content and landing pages to improve rankings, organic traffic, conversions and product sales

Create and brief engaging content including blogs, FAQs and search-focused resources

Support technical and on-site SEO improvements

Develop and execute off-site SEO and link-building strategies to improve domain authority, search visibility and organic performance

Monitor search trends and stay ahead of developments in AI-powered search and evolving customer behaviour

Reporting & Analysis

Produce insightful reports using Google Analytics 4 and platform data

Translate performance metrics into actionable recommendations

Support stakeholder reporting and performance reviews

Act as the day-to-day technical contact for PPC and SEO activity

What We're Looking For

We're keen to speak with candidates who have:

Minimum 12 months' hands-on PPC and SEO experience

Experience managing campaigns within Google Ads

Experience or exposure to Amazon Advertising would be highly advantageous

Strong understanding of how PPC and SEO work together to drive eCommerce and product sales, rather than purely lead generation

Experience with SEO best practices including keyword research, content optimisation and off-site/link-building activities

Strong analytical skills and confidence interpreting performance data

Experience using Google Analytics 4

Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills

Excellent attention to detail and organisational abilities

A commercial mindset and ability to make data-driven decisions

A genuine interest in the future of search and AI technologies

Desirable Experience

Amazon Advertising

Facebook Ads

Looker Studio Reporting

Experience developing and delivering successful off-site SEO and link-building campaigns

Experience within an eCommerce or product-led business, with a track record of driving product sales and revenue growth

What You'll Get In Return

25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

Hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days in the office

Excellent work-life balance:
- Monday-Thursday: 9:00am - 5:00pm
- Friday: 9:00am - 2:00pm

Smart salary sacrifice pension scheme with 5% employer contribution

Access to professional financial advice

Cycle to Work scheme

Private healthcare scheme

Free on-site parking

Apply Today

If you're looking for an opportunity to develop your digital marketing career within a forward-thinking business and want to play a key role in shaping PPC and SEO performance across both traditional and AI-powered search channels, please apply today.

title: Communications Executive
description:
Communications Executive -
Vacancy Type: Permanent/Full Time
Location: Stockton on Tees
Wolviston Management Services are recruiting on behalf of Tioxide Materials Ltd for a Communications Executive to join their Communications team at their head office in Stockton on Tees, please see details below;

Job Purpose:
Tioxide is looking for a Communications Executive to join its Business Services team and support communications activity across Tioxide and the wider LB Group.
Reporting to the Strategic Communications Manager, this is a varied role providing the opportunity to work across internal and external communications, digital channels, content development, marketing communications, brand management and business events.

The Communications Executive will develop engaging, high-quality content, help manage Tioxide's digital communication channels and support the delivery of communications projects and campaigns that strengthen the Tioxide brand and support wider business objectives.

This is an excellent opportunity for a communications professional looking to develop their career within an international manufacturing organisation, combining hands-on content creation with corporate, digital and strategic communications exposure.

Roles and Responsibilities:
- Content Development Develop and maintain high-quality communications materials including marketing literature, presentations, website content, social media content and internal communications, ensuring messaging is engaging, accurate and aligned with business and brand objectives.
- Digital Communications Support the management and development of Tioxide's digital communications channels, including websites, intranet, social media, webinars and email communications. Ensure content remains current, engaging and consistent with corporate brand standards.
- Marketing Communications Support Assist with the planning and delivery of integrated marketing communications activities, campaigns and customer-facing communications across the business.
- Communications Coordination Support the effective management of communications projects, schedules and workflows, working with colleagues and stakeholders to ensure activities are delivered to a high standard and within agreed timescales.
- Brand Governance Act as a Tioxide brand ambassador, helping ensure communications materials consistently reflect corporate branding, key messages and visual identity guidelines.
- Crisis and Issues Communications Provide communications support during business issues, incidents and crisis situations, assisting with the preparation and timely distribution of appropriate communications materials.
- Communications Centre of Excellence Support the delivery of Communications Centre of Excellence activities, providing content, digital and wider communications support for Tioxide and LB Group initiatives.
- Measurement and Reporting Maintain communications metrics, reporting tools and dashboards, monitoring the performance and effectiveness of communications activity and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

Experience and Qualifications:
Essential
- Degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
- Minimum of two years' experience within communications, marketing, public relations or a related role.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Excellent copywriting, editing and proofreading capability.
- Experience managing or supporting digital communications including websites, social media platforms and content management systems.
- Strong organisational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities and competing deadlines.
- Confident working with stakeholders across different functions and levels of an organisation.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and SharePoint.
- Experience using communications and content tools such as Canva, WordPress, Hootsuite or similar platforms.

Desirable
- Experience working within a manufacturing, chemical, engineering, energy or other industrial environment.
- Experience supporting both internal and external corporate communications.
- Experience of communications within a multi-site or international organisation.
- Exposure to crisis, incident or issues communications.
- Experience using communications analytics, performance metrics and reporting dashboards.
- Experience supporting corporate brand standards and brand governance.
- Experience coordinating events, webinars or other stakeholder communications activity.

Benefits
We offer a Workplace Pension Scheme via Legal & General, there is a 4% minimum employee contribution, the company will match your own contributions up to a maximum of 8%. We also allow employee Additional Voluntary Contributions to help you save for the future. Private Medical Insurance (optional), Life Assurance and Income Protection are all included as contractual benefits with us, providing desired security where it matters most.

About the Organisation
Tioxide manufactures premium-performance titanium dioxide (TiO2) pigments, marketed under the TIOXIDE and DELTIO brands, and supplied to customers worldwide across a range of essential applications.

Headquartered in Stockton-on-Tees in the UK, Tioxide combines more than 50 years of manufacturing heritage with advanced technical expertise, strong customer partnerships, and a commitment to continuous innovation.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of LB Group, the world's leading TiO2 pigment and titanium sponge manufacturer, Tioxide is entering an exciting new chapter. As the business continues to evolve, we are welcoming new talent to help build on our strong heritage and contribute to our future success.

At Tioxide, you'll have the chance to make a real impact in a business where people work together, take ownership, deliver on their commitments and continually look for better ways of doing things.
Whether you're starting your career or bringing years of experience, you'll be joining a business with a proud history, a supportive team and a clear vision for the future.
